senses.gloss: वद् (I) vt. or vi. 1P (but Atm. in certain senses and after certain prepositions) (pp. उदित; pres. वदति-ते; pass. उद्यते; desid. विवदिषति) 1. To speak, to say, to tell, to address, to utter, एहि गच्छ पतोत्तिष्ठ वद मौनं समाचर K.Pr.vii., R.i.59, xix.22; 2. to speak about, to inform, to communicate; 3. to describe, Bg.ii.29; 4. to name, to call, e.g. तदुपरागमिति वदंति लोकाः; 5. to utter a cry, to raise the voice, e.g. मयूरः षड्जेन वदति; 6. (Atm.) to shine, to look splendid, to look bright, Bt.viii.27; 7. (Atm.) to be an authority on, to show proficiency in, e.g. शास्त्रे वदते.; 8. (Atm.) to toil, e.g. क्षेत्रे वदते.With अनु-, 1. to repeat after, to say again what has been said, अनुवदति शुकस्ते मंजुवाक् पंजरस्थः R.v.74; 2. to resound; 3. to confirm, to ratify; 4. (Atm. and intransitive) to imitate (in loud and distinct speaking).With अप-, (Atm.) 1. to hate, (with a dat.), Bt.viii.45, M.iv.286; 2. to revile, to reproach.With अभि-, 1. to speak, to express, e.g. यद्वाचानभ्युदितं येन वागभ्युद्यते; 2. (Atm.) to salute with reverence.With उप-, (Atm.) 1. to flatter, to cajole; 2. to conciliate, to persuade.With परि-, to speak ill of.With प्र-, to call, to consider.With प्रति-, 1. to speak in reply; 2. to speak in general.With वि-, (Atm.) 1. to dispute, to controvert; 2. to litigate.With विप्र-, (U) to dipute, to wrangle.With विसम्-, to fail, to be inconsistent with.With सम्-, 1. to converse; 2. to speak to; 3. to call, to name; 4. to coincide, to resemble, (with an inst.)With संप्र-, (Atm.) to speak loudly together.
वद् Caus. (वादयति-ते) to cause to utter, to play on an instrument.With अभि-, to salute.With विसम्-, to make inconsistent.With सम्-, to consult, (with an inst.).

वद् (II) vt. 1Ā (pres. वंदते) 1. To make obeisance to, to do homage, to salute, जगतः पितरौ वंदे पार्व्वतीपरमेश्वरौ R.i.1, xiii.72, 77; 2. to worship, to adore; 3. to praise, to eulogize.With अभि-, to salute, to make obeisance to, R.xvi.81.
वद a. (f. दा) Speaking, speaking well.
वद a. (f. दा) Speaking, speaking well.

वाद m. 1. Talking, speaking; 2. an assertion, an allegation, अवाच्यवादांश्च बहून्वदिष्यंति तवाहिताः Bg.ii.26; 3. a speech, a statement, a communication, हरि हरि याहि माधव याहि केशव मा वद कैतववादम् Git.G.v.; 4. discussion, controversy, e.g. वादे वादे जायते तत्वबोधः; 5. a reply; 6. rumour, report; 7. sounding, sound; 8. an exposition; 9. a demonstrated conclusion; 10. a plaint, M.viii.253.
वदन n. 1. The face, यूनां मनः सुवदने नियतं हरंति Rt.vi.21, प्रालेयास्रं कमलवदनात्सोऽपि हर्तुं नलिन्याः Megh.i.39, ii.15; 2. the mouth; 3. look, appearance; 4. the front.
वादन n. 1. Sounding; 2. instrumental music.
वदन-आसव m. saliva.
वदंती f. Speech, discourse.
वदन्य a. The same as वदान्य q.v.
वदान्य (I) a. (f. न्या) 1. Liberal, beneficient; 2. eloquent; 3. speaking kindly.
वदान्य (II) m. A munificent man, a bountiful man, गतो वदान्यांतरमित्ययं मे मा भूत्परीवादनवावतारः R.v.24, Na.v.11.
वदान्य (I) a. (f. न्या) 1. Liberal, beneficient; 2. eloquent; 3. speaking kindly.
वदर m. The same as बदर q.v.
वादर (I) a. (f. री) Made of cotton.
वादर (II) m. Cotton cloth.
वादरा f. The same as बादरा q.v.
वदाल m. 1. A whirlpool; 2. a kind of sheat-fish.
वादाल m. The sheat-fish.
वदावद a. (f. दा) Eloquent, talkative.
वदावद a. (f. दा) Eloquent, talkative.
वदि ind. In the dark half of (any month), e.g. वैशाखवदि.
वादि a. Learned, wise.
वद्य (I) a. (f. द्या) 1. Unblamable; 2. the second or dark (fortnight of a lunar month).
वद्य (II) n. Speech, speaking.
वद्य (I) a. (f. द्या) 1. Unblamable; 2. the second or dark (fortnight of a lunar month).
वाद्य n. 1. A musical instrument; 2. the sound of a musical instrument, R.xvi.64.
वाद-अनुवाद m. du. assertion and reply, accusation and defence.
वाद-ग्रस्त a. in dispute.
वाद-चंचु a. clever in repartee.
वाद-युद्ध n. a controversy, a dispute.
वाद-विवाद m. discussion, debate, disputation.
वादर (I) a. (f. री) Made of cotton.
वादरंग m. the sacred fig tree.
वादरायण m. the same as बादरायण q.v.
वादित a. (f. ता) 1. Played, sounded; 2. made to speak.
वादित a. (f. ता) 1. Played, sounded; 2. made to speak.
वादित्र n. A musical instrument, M.iv.64.
वादिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Speaking, discoursing; 2. disputing.
वादिन् (II) m. 1. A disputant, an adversary, an antagonist, R.xii.92; 2. a speaker; 3. a plaintiff, an accuser.
वादिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Speaking, discoursing; 2. disputing.
वादिश m. A Paṇḍit, a learned man.
वाद्य-कर m. a musician.
वाद्य-भांड n. 1. a musical instrument; 2. a number of musical instruments.
